steps.en: The company hirer's email is taken from the government data source
steps.id: Email perusahaan hirer diambil dari sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The refresh is switched off in all environments; the email already stored is used instead.
steps.why_id: Pengambilan data terbaru dimatikan di semua environment; email yang sudah tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each company hirer is meant to get one email for its fines
steps.id: Tiap perusahaan hirer seharusnya dapat satu email untuk dendanya
steps.why_en: One company can still get several emails when its fines have different due dates or stages.
steps.why_id: Satu perusahaan masih bisa dapat beberapa email bila dendanya beda tanggal jatuh tempo atau tahap.

steps.en: The email lists the fines and mentions the first letter
steps.id: Email memuat daftar denda dan menyebut surat pertama
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored outside the code, so the list and the letter reference cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di luar code, jadi daftar denda dan rujukan ke surat tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: The email goes to the company and the result is saved
steps.id: Email dikirim ke perusahaan dan hasilnya disimpan
steps.why_en: Email sending and the daily schedule are switched off in the production settings, so nothing is sent as configured.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email dimatikan di pengaturan produksi dan jadwal harian mati, jadi dengan konfigurasi ini tidak ada yang terkirim.
